## Returns & exchanges

Because fragrance is a personal-care product, we can only accept returns of **unopened** signature blends within [X] days of delivery. Personalised blends are made specially for you and can’t be returned or exchanged.

If your order arrives damaged or incorrect, message us on WhatsApp within [X] days with a photo and we’ll make it right.
